QuestInfo.name: [Mentoring] Cooperative Journaling
QuestInfo.0: Fight on the same map with your Mentor or Protege to get a Mentoring Diary.
QuestInfo.1: Monsters will drop a Mentoring Diary if both a Mentor and Protege are on the same map. #bStick around to help once you get yours!#k
QuestInfo.2: Mentoring Diary acquired! Never forget where you came from.
